summary: Your mission rationale is a clear strength: you identify reef-monitoring users and link satellite data to bleaching prediction with references. To reach the next level, quantify requirements, strengthen the plan with contingencies and sources, correct the orbit error, add preliminary technical results, and complete figure captions and a full reference list.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, convert goals into measurable requirements (revisit time, spatial resolution, spectral bands, latency, coverage, lifetime) and tie each to user needs; this is what C1 Accomplished requires.

In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, correct the 'geostationary orbit at 600 km' statement (GEO is ~35,786 km; 600 km is LEO), add contingency provisions and planned information sources for launch/orbit/design, and clarify Gantt deadlines/red lines and STK timing.

Add preliminary design results/calculations with brief interpretation, caption Image 1, and replace footnote/URL citations with a full reference list matching in-text citations; these target C3 and C4 Accomplished.
